title: ReviewPayload
description: Machine-readable output of The Reviewer. Rendered to review-report.md and review-report.html by scripts/render_report.py — the model writes only this payload, never the reports (PRF-21). Rationale for non-obvious fields is in maintainer-local DECISIONS.md (not in this repo).
$comment: Version history. 1.0 (2026-09-28): initial freeze. 1.1 (2026-09-29): rollup.epic_child_inventory[].content_source required (C4); Epic scope may not carry CRITICAL findings or a BLOCKED gate (PRF-12); new required `report` block holding all rendered prose (PRF-21); finding.testing_impact; context_loaded[].detail and status `not_applicable`; requirements[].status/url; question.owner_hint accepts Security; scope.lifecycle (PRF-15); category `epic_lifecycle` and checklist_ref C1-C3 (PRF-19); report.question_cap_reason (PRF-13); recommended_batch_keys maxItems removed (PRF-16). The PRF-13/16/19 additions were made after a 1.1 run existed, under the widening exception. Rule (PRF-20, amended 2026-09-29): a change that makes previously valid payloads invalid (new required field, removed or narrowed allowed value, tighter limit) bumps the version; a change that only widens what's allowed (new optional field, new allowed value, looser limit) does not, and is recorded here.

allOf.$comment: PRF-12: Epic mode never blocks — no CRITICAL finding, gate never BLOCKED.

payload_version.description: Renderer refuses any version other than the one it was built for, with a clear message (decision A3). A rescan against an older persisted version runs a full scan instead of a delta (PRF-20).

scan_label.description: Rendered with the date next to it, so chat/HTML/Jira-comment references to 'the latest scan' are unambiguous.

host.description: Which of the three fully-supported hosts (decision D2/D13) produced this run.

product.description: The per-product config id resolved for this run (decision A9).

issue_type.description: The literal Jira issue type name, so output text can substitute it (decision D8) instead of always saying 'story'.

lifecycle.description: Epic scope only (PRF-15). post_delivery when the Epic's status category is Done or its status is Waiting for Release/Deploy (or equivalent). Changes wording only — never severities or readiness.

is_epic_batch.description: True when this run also produced/updated the epic batch handoff (decision RV4 — epic batch ships in v1).

requirement_keys.description: May be empty when scope.type is 'bundle' or another non-Jira scope (decision A-5 — relaxed from the original schema's minItems:1).

source_ref.description: Free-text pointer to the source when requirement_keys is empty (decision A-5) — e.g. a bundle file path.

requirement_fingerprint.description: Hash of the normalized, review-relevant requirement bundle at generation time. Any later reader (a rescan, or The Creator's gate check) re-fetches the live requirement, recomputes this, and flags STALE before trusting a cached result (decisions R-G4 / U-8).

context_loaded.description: Every source attempted, Jira or otherwise, with outcome. Makes 'the agent never read the linked Confluence page' visible instead of invisible.

detail.description: What was read, for an analyzed source — e.g. '2 comments, no new facts beyond description'. Rendered in the Data sources table.

reason.description: Required when status is unavailable or failed, e.g. 'Comments (403 permission denied)'.

requirements.description: The normalized, review-relevant bundle(s) actually analysed (narrow scope — decision 'bundle richness'). Not the full requirements-template.md shape.

url.description: Browse URL of the issue; rendered as the report header's Jira link.

questions.description: Clarification Questions — a mandatory, fully-specified output section (decision: 'Clarification Questions addendum'), not an afterthought of the limits table.

suggested_level.description: A logical level, never a specific framework (decision A-18). Framework name comes from per-product config.

value.description: Independent of gate.status (PRF-10, amends RV1): computed from testability, test scope confidence, and open-question priority, not from severity counts. Any combination with gate.status is valid.

enum: Needs clarification before scope can be tested
human_label.description: The only headline shown to a PM. Never 'gate', 'blocked', or 'failed' (decision RV1).

blocking_refs.description: Top blocking finding_id(s) and/or question_id(s), cited in one line — collaborative framing, not a verdict.

rollup.description: Populated for multi-issue (stories/jql) or epic scope only.

epic_child_inventory.description: Full inventory, paginated to isLast — never a 'sample' (decision A-14). Each child's description is fetched in the same paginated call, not a separate per-child round trip (decision C4).

description_excerpt.description: Verbatim excerpt from the child's description field, redacted per A7 before it reaches this field. Empty when content_source is not 'description'.

content_source.description: Which signal fed this child's contribution to B12/epic-narrative analysis (decision C4): its own description text, a title-only fallback to summary when the description was empty/boilerplate (never sufficient alone to mark B12 COVERED — A-17), or unavailable if the field couldn't be read at all.

recommended_batch_keys.description: Decision RV4/R-G10, PRF-16 — every non-Canceled child, no cap, ranked: most-named by open findings/questions, then status (WFR/In Progress, To Do, Done), then key. Computed directly by The Reviewer.

qa_readiness_checklist.description: Included when >=3 suggested-testing-focus items, a spreadsheet was ingested, or the user asked. Labelled 'preliminary' until after a rescan.

blocks_test_generation.description: Computed read-only: true iff status == BLOCKED and force_override is not true. Never authored directly (decision A-4).

report.description: Every piece of prose the reports render that isn't already a structured field above (PRF-21). The renderer adds nothing of its own beyond fixed labels, counts, and the gate line.

readiness_line.description: One collaborative sentence under the readiness label, citing the top blocking finding/question ids. No blocked phrases.

facts.description: 'Information identified' — every bullet carries a Source.

not_stated.description: Gaps named plainly, never with a guessed answer.

blocks.description: finding_id(s)/question_id(s) this focus item waits on.

design_observations.description: Literal Figma text only. The section renders only when at least one figma_node was analyzed.

epic_context.description: Story/Bug/Task scope: parent Epic and sibling facts, plus any factual epic↔story inconsistency.

batch_rationale.description: Epic scope: why these recommended_batch_keys, in one or two sentences.

handoff_note.description: Optional extra sentence for the always-visible handoff block.

question_cap_reason.description: Required by the renderer lint when more than 5 questions are High priority (PRF-13): why merging related questions was not enough.

rescan.description: Present only when scan_label == 'Rescan'. Diffs against the persisted payload for the same requirement_keys, never against chat memory (decisions D5/R-G3).

questions_new.description: Decision A-16/second confirmation: capped at 5 new per rescan; no cumulative open-question ceiling exists.

errors.description: Per-key operational errors. A batch continues past one failed key (decision: graceful degradation, Similarity #10).

source.description: Rendered as '(Source: …)'. Required for facts and design observations by SKILL.md §14; optional for risks drawn from gap analysis.

checklist_ref.description: Points at exactly one row of checklist.md. Required on every finding (decision D15/RV3) — not optional as in the original schema.

excerpt_quote.description: Verbatim from the analyzed source — never paraphrased. Redacted at display time per A7 before it reaches this field.

testing_impact.description: One line: what QA cannot do until this is resolved. Rendered as the 'Testing impact' column.

owner_hint.description: Generalises PM-only ownership to the personas that can actually act on a finding (decision R-G8).

blocks_test_generation.description: Computed read-only: true iff severity == CRITICAL. Never authored directly (decision A-4).

topic.description: Any topic is valid in any scope (PRF-17). The last four are preferred for epic-level concerns. question_id is assigned in display order after grouping (reference.md → Question topic order).

unblocks.description: finding_id(s) and/or checklist_ref(s) this question unblocks.

owner_hint.description: Epic-scope questions route to PO/UX/EM rather than assuming PM (decision R-G8); epic-scope AC/scope questions default to PO (PRF-17).
